name: Speaking
overview: Scripture reveals the profound power and responsibility in speaking, urging restraint and wisdom as seen in Job's counsel that holding one's peace can be true wisdom. The danger of vain and harmful words is highlighted by Job's lament over empty speech and the pain caused by others speaking against him. At the same time, speech has the capacity to strengthen and comfort, demonstrating that the mouth can be used to assuage grief rather than inflame it. Additionally, commands against reviling rulers or gods emphasize the need for reverence and respect in our words.
